scope: Appendix F.2 OQ_002 bell-curve derivability reduction.
directly_defined: RT_core alone does not currently derive a bell curve.
A bell-curve or normal-like statistical shape requires declared iff_s projection conditions.
The textbook Chapter 7 phrasing is narrowed from bell-curve emergence to central-tendency projection candidate.
inferred_inside_framework: Exclusion/addition asymmetry may motivate a statistical projection question.
Projection shape is downstream of F_s, observation window, ensemble, normalization, aggregation, and convergence assumptions.
external_resemblance: Normal-like projection is treated only as a representational resemblance under declared statistical conditions.
does_not_prove: No central-limit theorem is imported into RT_core.
No empirical or physical distribution claim is made.
failure_modes: Skewed distributions may occur when exclusion/addition balance is asymmetric.
Heavy-tailed distributions may occur when bounded-tail conditions fail.
Multimodal distributions may occur when the observation window mixes non-equivalent regimes.
Non-convergent outputs may occur when ensemble or aggregation rules are invalid.
